svg.style: background-color: #f2f2ee; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;

g.text: Multi-tier railway operations platform featuring segment-aware berth allocation, atomic serializable transactions, controlled AI tooling, and multi-provider failover telemetry.
Origin/Dest station lookup, quota types (General/Tatkal), dynamic fare quotes in paise.
Passenger manifest (1-6), berth preference, UPI/Card gateway simulation with 10m TTL.
10-digit PNR lookup, confirmed coach/seat #, print pass, tiered departure refund engine.
Leaflet GeoJSON route vector, live station clearance board, delay & platform tracking.
Master Train/Station CRUD, rake stats, conversational AI assistant panel with tool execution.

• AuthContext (User & Role state)
• ThemeContext (Light & Dark tokens)
• Axios Client (Credentials & Anti-CSRF)
Session regeneration on login, Zod body validation middleware, global error interceptor, Swagger /api/docs.
Segment overlap intersection check: bSeq < toRS && aSeq > fromRS. Allows non-overlapping passengers to share seats on same train run.
2-Phase seat hold (LOCKED with 10m TTL), auto-recovery cron, unique 10-digit PNR generation, cancellation refund tiered fee calculation.
Authoritative server calculation in integer paise. Distance multipliers, quota surcharges (Tatkal), 5% GST, zero reliance on client prices.
5 strictly bounded tools: search_trains, get_fare, get_booking_status, get_my_bookings, get_train_running_status. Zero direct DB mutation.
In-memory TTL cache (60s), multi-tier provider cascade, rate-limiting budgets (10 req/min), normalized NormalizedRunningStatus.
Enforced Serializable isolation level inside prisma.$transaction ensuring zero dirty reads or phantom seat collisions.

• RouteStation (Sequence offsets, halt min, km)
• TrainSchedule (7-bit running days bitmask)
• TrainRun (Calendar journey instances)

• Express classes: 1A, 2A, 3A, SL, CC, EC
• SeatAllocation: boardingSeq, alightingSeq
• Status: LOCKED | CONFIRMED | RELEASED

• Booking (Unique 10-digit PNR, PENDING/CONFIRMED)
• PaymentTransaction (idempotencyKey)
• Cancellation (deductionPercent, refundAmount)
Gemini Flash LLM via @google/genai. Generates tool calling intents evaluated against server ToolRegistry. System prompt prohibits hallucinating fares or direct database edits.
Deterministic schedule math on local DB
Independent non-colliding segments share the same berth
idempotencyKey & state guards prevent duplicate charges
LLM limited to 5 read-only queries with zero direct DB control
